harmony.note: one chord per bar (2 s). Hits: logo-hit on C at 4.0, counter-hit on C at 22.0 (after G), handshake on C at 60.0, the motif on the logo at 61.0, Cadd9 from 62.0.

sections.name: hook
sections.brief: Observant. No drums: a dark drone, a faint heartbeat, the harmony left open; 0.25 s of near-silence before the hit at 4.0.

sections.name: idea
sections.brief: First resolution on C: the logo hit, the motif's question (G-A). The sub pulse begins, half-time.

sections.name: handoff
sections.brief: A pad on G, a soft pulse, the shop's room tone; the interface takes over as the camera enters the tablet.

sections.name: form
sections.brief: Pad and a sparse felt piano; room for the language ticks, the typing texture, the consent click and the taps.

sections.name: swipes
sections.brief: The swipes are the rhythm: tuned yes (rising, right) and no (falling, left) phrases over a pad and the pulse; no keys.

sections.name: scan
sections.brief: A tonal riser, the pad opens, everything cuts for 0.25 s of air before the 98 %.

sections.name: match
sections.brief: The 98 % bloom on C: the first, smaller peak. A rolled felt chord, a glass shimmer, then calm.

sections.name: email
sections.brief: Intimate: low-passed felt piano, the pulse on beat 1 only. The notification and the code ding sit on top.

sections.name: store
sections.brief: Steady and competent: a firm sub pulse and one quiet off-beat tick, confident chords; one soft 'land' when a lead reaches the CRM.

sections.name: consult
sections.brief: Calm, a place to learn: the e-mail's low-passed felt piano again, a light pulse; the search, the tap and the two call-outs are small glass ticks.

sections.name: system
sections.brief: Precise and calm: gated pad and staccato plucks, less busy than before; the pulse stops cleanly at 57.5.

sections.name: human
sections.brief: Warm and quiet: a soft pad and felt keys on G leaning towards C, the room tone, the bag rustle; no pulse.

sections.name: resolve
sections.brief: ★ The handshake: the film's one big resolved C chord, full and warm, no cymbal; the motif completes on the logo at 61.0.

sections.name: signature
sections.brief: Cadd9 rings; the last second is still and the tail fades to true silence.
